description: events since a cursor, for alert bots: confluence (several top traders bought the same coin recently), big_trade (one tracked trader bought or sold a large amount) and thesis (a tracked trader posted a thesis). pass the cursor of the previous call as since; without since, the last 15 minutes. thresholds are yours.

max_mcap_usd.description: ignore coins above this market cap

min_trade_usd.description: big trade threshold in dollars, default 5000

since.description: the cursor of the previous call (iso time)

name: get_alerts
title: alerts since a cursor
